note: Use this map to tell a learner which light a quest or mission belongs to and what comes next. It changes no quest content. PARA is Tiago Forte's method; STELLAR is an open, draft Starlight method.

lights.name: Spark
lights.doorQuestion: A convincing answer. Which part of it would you stake your name on?
proof: One question, one answer, one marked-up copy.
At least one claim traced to a source you opened.
One sentence on what you would ask differently next time.

lights.name: Companion
lights.doorQuestion: Would a capable stranger know what done looks like from your brief alone?
proof: A brief with context, constraints and acceptance checks.
The first output and the revised output side by side.
A note on which instruction changed the result.

lights.name: Second Brain
lights.doorQuestion: If your agent remembered everything you told it, what would you want it to forget?
proof: A PARA folder for one active project.
Three retrieval questions with the sources they returned.
One item you chose to delete, and why.

lights.name: Orchestrator
lights.becomes: Runs a small team of agents
lights.doorQuestion: Before you look at the results: which agent do you expect to be wrong, and how will you know?
proof: A task split with one output per agent.
A review record that names one disagreement.
A recovery note for one failed step.

lights.name: Operator
lights.doorQuestion: Who can stop this workflow, and what happens downstream when it runs?
proof: A workflow card with owner, authority and stop condition.
Two weeks of receipts.
One change made because of what a receipt showed.

lights.name: Architect
lights.becomes: Takes an agent system to production
lights.doorQuestion: What would your evaluation miss, and who finds out first when it does?
lights.handoff: AI Architect Academy, the Starlight technical school. Use the connect-ai-architect skill for the handoff.
proof: An evaluation set with a failure case.
A tool-authority record.
An independent review of the exact revision.

lights.name: Steward
lights.doorQuestion: Who inherits this decision, and can they change it?
proof: A public portfolio entry with sources and limits.
One peer review given.
One decision record that names who can reverse it.
